data.title: Rejection of forest road driving permit
data.summary: The district office (Landratsamt Beispielkreis) rejected your application of 14 October 2025 for an exception permit to drive on the forest road "Am Hochries". The decision is dated 2 December 2025 and no costs are charged.
data.explanation: Your application for an exception permit to drive a motor vehicle on the forest road was rejected. The authority says the road is closed to general traffic, no special need was shown, and your property can be reached via the municipal road. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or by recording it in person at the Landratsamt; the app shows the deadline. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. You may want professional advice if access to your property matters.
